strings.Jakie zasiłki i świadczenia przysługują: Which allowances and benefits a foreigner who legally lives and works in Poland is entitled to — from ZUS, the labour office, family benefits (800+) and social assistance. We explain the conditions, the legal basis and help you file the application.

strings.<a href=\"#zasada\">Od czego zależy praw: What your right to benefits depends on
strings.Od czego zależy prawo do świadczeń: What your right to benefits depends on
strings.To nie obywatelstwo decyduje o prawie do: It is not citizenship that decides your right to a benefit, but a combination of four elements. The same foreigner may be entitled to one benefit and not to another.
strings.Rodzaj i podstawa Twojego legalnego poby: The type and basis of your legal stay (stamp after filing the application, residence card, permanent residence). The "stronger" it is, the broader your access to benefits.
strings.Zezwolenie na pracę, oświadczenie albo p: A work permit, a declaration, or temporary residence and work — plus the annotation "access to the labour market", which is crucial for 800+.
strings.Czy i do jakich ubezpieczeń jesteś zgłos: Whether and to which insurance you are registered — especially sickness insurance. Your allowances depend on it: sickness, maternity, care.
strings.Część świadczeń rodzinnych i pomoc społe: Some family benefits and social assistance depend on income per person in the family. ZUS allowances — do not.
strings.<b>W skrócie:</b> najpewniejsze są świad: In short: the most reliable are ZUS benefits (they depend on contributions, not on citizenship). Family benefits and social assistance more often require a "stronger" residence title than just the stamp after filing the application.
strings.Każdą grupę opisujemy osobno — kliknij,: We describe each group separately — click to go to the detailed guide with conditions and legal basis.
strings.Chorobowy, opiekuńczy, macierzyński, reh: Sickness, care, maternity, rehabilitation, accident and — in the long term — pension and retirement.
strings.Świadczenie wychowawcze 800+, zasiłek ro: The 800+ child-raising benefit, family allowance with supplements, parental benefit.
strings.Rejestracja w urzędzie pracy, warunki na: Registration at the labour office, conditions for acquiring the right to the benefit, labour-market instruments.
strings.Zasiłek okresowy i celowy, dodatek miesz: Periodic and purpose-specific allowance, housing supplement and other municipal benefits depending on residence title and income.
strings.Zasiłki z ZUS — co otwiera legalna praca: ZUS allowances — what legal work and contributions unlock
strings.Świadczenia z ubezpieczenia społecznego: Social insurance benefits depend on being covered by insurance (especially sickness insurance), not on citizenship. If you work legally and are registered with ZUS, you have the same access to them as a Polish citizen.
strings.Po tzw. okresie wyczekiwania: <b>30 dni<: After the so-called qualifying period: 30 days for compulsory insurance (employment contract) or 90 days for voluntary insurance (mandate contract).
strings.Na opiekę nad chorym dzieckiem lub innym: For caring for a sick child or another family member. No qualifying period — from the first day of sickness insurance.
strings.Przy objęciu ubezpieczeniem chorobowym i: On being covered by sickness insurance and the birth/adoption of a child. Also no qualifying period.
strings.Po wyczerpaniu zasiłku chorobowego, gdy: After the sickness allowance is exhausted, when further treatment offers a prospect of regaining the ability to work.
strings.Gdy niezdolność do pracy wynika z wypadk: When the inability to work results from an accident at work or an occupational disease — no qualifying period.
strings.Świadczenia długofalowe, zależne od prze: Long-term benefits, depending on the insurance history and statutory conditions.
strings.Umowa o pracę a umowa zlecenia — najważn: Employment contract vs. mandate contract — the key differences
strings.Liczy się, jeśli odprowadzano Fundusz Pr: Counts if the Labour Fund was paid
strings.<b>Przy zleceniu zawsze sprawdź:</b> czy: With a mandate contract, always check: whether you were registered for sickness insurance. Without it there is no sickness or maternity allowance. It is worth asking the employer for confirmation of registration (ZUS ZUA/RCA).
strings.Świadczenie wychowawcze <b>800+</b> przy: The 800+ child-raising benefit is available, among others, to foreigners who hold a residence card with the annotation "access to the labour market", if they live in Poland together with their children — as well as to people with permanent residence, refugee status, subsidiary or humanitarian protection. Excluded are, among others, foreigners with the right to work for up to 6 months, those staying for studies or on the basis of a visa alone.
strings.Zasiłek rodzinny zależy dodatkowo od <b>: The family allowance additionally depends on the income criterion. For a foreigner, the key factors are the appropriate residence title and the PESEL numbers of family members.
strings.<a href=\"swiadczenia-rodzinne-800-plus-: Full guide: 800+ and family benefits for foreigners →
strings.Aby zarejestrować się w urzędzie pracy j: To register at the labour office as an unemployed person, a foreigner must hold an appropriate residence title (among others permanent residence, temporary residence for a family member of a Polish citizen, temporary residence and work, or a visa for the purpose of work). The right to the benefit arises after proving at least 365 days of work with Labour Fund contributions paid within the 18 months before registration.
strings.<b>W praktyce:</b> po kilku miesiącach p: In practice: after a few months of work the service period is usually not yet enough; after about a year the situation looks much better. Even without a right to the benefit, you can use some labour-market services. Full guide →
strings.Zasiłek okresowy, celowy czy dodatek mie: A periodic or purpose-specific allowance or a housing supplement may be available, but only to foreigners from a narrow statutory catalogue — most often with permanent residence, EU long-term resident status, or temporary residence granted on specific grounds (e.g. as a family member of a Polish citizen). Temporary residence "and work" alone is usually not enough. An income criterion also applies.
strings.<b>Tu najczęściej powstają spory</b> na: This is where disputes most often arise at the intersection of the type of residence and the interpretation of the social assistance centre. Before filing, it is worth checking the exact residence basis. Full guide →

strings.Czy cudzoziemiec na umowie zlecenia ma p: Is a foreigner on a mandate contract entitled to sickness allowance?
strings.Tak, ale tylko jeśli przystąpił do dobro: Yes, but only if they opted into voluntary sickness insurance and the 90-day qualifying period has elapsed. With an employment contract, sickness insurance is compulsory and the qualifying period is 30 days.
strings.Czy dostanę 800+ na dziecko, mając pobyt: Will I get 800+ for my child if I have temporary residence and work?
strings.Kluczowa jest adnotacja „dostęp do rynku: The key factor is the "access to the labour market" annotation on the residence card and living together with the child in Poland. The stamp after filing the application alone is often insufficient — each situation must be assessed individually.
strings.Po jakim czasie pracy mogę dostać zasiłe: After how long of working can I get unemployment benefit?
strings.Co do zasady po wykazaniu 365 dni pracy: As a rule, after proving 365 days of work with Labour Fund contributions paid within the 18 months before registration at the labour office — and provided you hold an appropriate residence title.
strings.Czy prawo do świadczeń zależy od obywate: Does the right to benefits depend on citizenship?
strings.Nie wprost. Decyduje kombinacja: tytuł p: Not directly. It is decided by a combination: residence title, right to work, ZUS insurance coverage and — for some benefits — the income criterion.
strings.Ustawa z 25 czerwca 1999 r. o świadczeni: Act of 25 June 1999 on cash benefits from social insurance in the event of sickness and maternity (the so-called benefits act).

strings.Kto podlega i co daje ubezpieczenie: Who is covered and what insurance provides
strings.Zasiłki z ZUS zależą od tego, czy i do j: ZUS allowances depend on whether and to which insurance you are registered — not on citizenship. If you work legally and are covered by sickness insurance, you have the same access to them as a Polish citizen.
strings.Ubezpieczenie chorobowe jest <b>obowiązk: Sickness insurance is compulsory — you are covered from the first day of employment.
strings.Ubezpieczenie chorobowe jest <b>dobrowol: Sickness insurance is voluntary — you must opt in (registration by the employer). Without it there is no sickness or maternity allowance.
strings.<b>Sprawdź to koniecznie:</b> poproś pra: Be sure to check this: ask the employer for confirmation of registration for sickness insurance (ZUS ZUA). With a mandate contract this is the most common reason for a benefit refusal.
strings.Przysługuje po tzw. <b>okresie wyczekiwa: It is granted after the so-called qualifying period — that is, after a certain time of uninterrupted sickness insurance:
strings.Do okresu wyczekiwania zalicza się poprz: Previous periods of sickness insurance count towards the qualifying period if the break between them did not exceed 30 days. The sickness allowance is, as a rule, 80% of the assessment basis (there are exceptions, e.g. 100% during pregnancy or for an accident on the way to/from work).
strings.Przy objęciu ubezpieczeniem chorobowym i: On being covered by sickness insurance and the birth/adoption of a child. No qualifying period — from the first day of insurance.
strings.Na osobistą opiekę nad chorym dzieckiem: For personal care of a sick child or another family member. Also no qualifying period. Annual day limits apply.
strings.Po wyczerpaniu zasiłku chorobowego, gdy: After the sickness allowance is exhausted, when further treatment or rehabilitation offers a prospect of regaining the ability to work.
strings.Gdy niezdolność wynika z wypadku przy pr: When the incapacity results from an accident at work or an occupational disease — from accident insurance, with no qualifying period.
strings.Świadczenie długofalowe zależne od stażu: A long-term benefit depending on the insurance history and a ruling on inability to work.
strings.Zależna od przebiegu ubezpieczenia; okre: Depends on the insurance history; contribution periods in Poland count towards a future benefit.
strings.Od 1. dnia, jeśli objęty chorobowym: From day 1, if covered by sickness insurance
strings.Aby sprawnie wykazać prawo do świadczeni: To prove your right to a benefit efficiently, prepare: the contract (employment or mandate), confirmation of insurance registration (ZUS ZUA), payslips/salary confirmations, the medical certificate (e-ZLA) and — for a mandate contract — proof of opting into voluntary sickness insurance.

strings.Podaj rodzaj umowy i datę zgłoszenia do: Give the type of contract and the date of insurance registration — we will assess whether the qualifying period has elapsed and what you can apply for.

strings.Czy cudzoziemiec na zleceniu ma prawo do: Is a foreigner on a mandate contract entitled to sickness allowance?
strings.Tak, jeśli przystąpił do dobrowolnego ub: Yes, if they opted into voluntary sickness insurance and the 90-day qualifying period has elapsed.
strings.Czy zasiłek macierzyński ma okres wyczek: Does maternity allowance have a qualifying period?
strings.Nie. Zasiłek macierzyński i opiekuńczy p: No. Maternity and care allowance are granted from the first day of being covered by sickness insurance.
strings.Czy zmiana pracodawcy przerywa staż do c: Does changing employer interrupt the service period for sickness allowance?
strings.Poprzednie okresy ubezpieczenia chorobow: Previous periods of sickness insurance count if the break did not exceed 30 days.
strings.Czy okresy pracy w Polsce liczą się do e: Do periods of work in Poland count towards a pension?
strings.Tak, okresy składkowe w polskim ZUS licz: Yes, contribution periods in the Polish ZUS count towards a future retirement or incapacity pension.
strings.Ustawa z 25 czerwca 1999 r. o świadczeni: Act of 25 June 1999 on cash benefits from social insurance in the event of sickness and maternity (the benefits act).

strings.Treść ma charakter informacyjny i nie st: The content is informational and does not constitute legal advice. Conditions, requirements and thresholds are subject to change and depend on the individual situation (type of residence title, form of employment, ZUS registrations, income). Specific article numbers and current amounts require verification for a given case — we will gladly carry it out. Legal status: 07.2026.

strings.Świadczenie wychowawcze 800+ (wypłacane: The 800+ child-raising benefit (paid by ZUS) is available, among others, to foreigners holding a residence card with the annotation "access to the labour market", if they live in Poland together with their children.
strings.Karta pobytu z adnotacją „dostęp do rynk: A residence card with the "access to the labour market" annotation, permanent residence, refugee status, subsidiary protection, consent to stay for humanitarian reasons.
strings.Dziecko i rodzic muszą faktycznie mieszk: The child and parent must actually live in Poland. PESEL numbers are also needed.
strings.Ze świadczenia 800+ wyłączeni są m.in. c: Excluded from the 800+ benefit are, among others, foreigners entitled to work in the territory of an EU state for a period of up to 6 months, staying in Poland for the purpose of studies, and persons whose right to work results solely from a visa. In such situations the mere fact of working is not enough.
strings.<b>W praktyce:</b> to właśnie tu najczęś: In practice: this is exactly where refusals most often occur. The type of residence title and the content of the card annotation must be assessed individually.
strings.Zasiłek rodzinny (wypłacany przez gminę): The family allowance (paid by the municipality) additionally depends on the income criterion per person in the family — the threshold is set periodically. Supplements may be added to the allowance, e.g. for the birth of a child, single parenting or the start of the school year.
strings.Krąg uprawnionych cudzoziemców jest wężs: The group of eligible foreigners is narrower than for 800+ and is based, among others, on permanent residence, EU long-term resident status or temporary residence granted on specific grounds, as well as on the rules on the coordination of social security.
strings.Świadczenie rodzicielskie i fundusz alim: Parental benefit and the maintenance fund
strings.Może mieć znaczenie, gdy brak prawa do z: It may matter when there is no right to maternity allowance from insurance. It is granted for a set time after the birth of a child.
strings.Wymaga odpowiedniego tytułu pobytu i spe: Requires an appropriate residence title and meeting the income criterion; not every foreigner will be eligible.
strings.Jak i gdzie złożyć wniosek: How and where to file the application
strings.Wniosek o 800+ składa się elektronicznie: The 800+ application is filed electronically (e.g. via PUE ZUS / the ZUS mobile app or electronic banking). Family benefits from the municipality — via the Emp@tia portal or at the office. Prepare: a residence document with the annotation, the PESEL numbers of the child and parent, and payment details.

strings.Czy dostanę 800+ mając pobyt czasowy i p: Will I get 800+ if I have temporary residence and work?
strings.Kluczowa jest adnotacja „dostęp do rynku: The key factor is the "access to the labour market" annotation on the residence card and living together with the child in Poland. The stamp after filing the application alone is sometimes insufficient.
strings.Czy student z zagranicy dostanie 800+?: Will a student from abroad get 800+?
strings.Co do zasady nie — pobyt w celu studiów: As a rule no — residence for the purpose of studies is one of the grounds excluding the right to the benefit.
strings.Świadczenie wychowawcze 800+ obsługuje i: The 800+ child-raising benefit is handled and paid by ZUS; the application is filed electronically.
strings.Czy zasiłek rodzinny zależy od dochodu?: Does the family allowance depend on income?
strings.Tak, obowiązuje kryterium dochodowe na o: Yes, an income criterion per person in the family applies, set periodically.
strings.Przepisy o koordynacji systemów zabezpie: Rules on the coordination of social security systems (EU).

strings.Zasiłek dla cudzoziemca — <em>bezrobocie: Benefit for a foreigner — unemployment and the labour office
strings.Kto może zarejestrować się jako bezrobot: Who can register as unemployed, when the benefit is due (365 days within 18 months), how much it is, and what the new 2025 labour market act changed.
strings.<a class=\"btn btn-gold\" href=\"formula: Check your right → Back to overview
strings.<span class=\"pill\">💼 Rejestracja</span: 💼 Registration📅 365 days / 18 months🎓 Training🆕 2025 Act
strings.<a href=\"#ile\">Ile wynosi i jak długo<: How much and for how long
strings.Aby uzyskać status osoby bezrobotnej, cu: To obtain the status of an unemployed person, a foreigner must hold one of the residence titles specified in the act — among others a permanent residence permit, temporary residence for a family member of a Polish citizen, a temporary residence and work permit, or a visa issued for the purpose of work.
strings.<b>Ważne:</b> sama rejestracja (status b: Important: registration itself (the status of an unemployed or job-seeking person) is different from the right to a benefit. Registration gives access to labour-market services even without the right to the benefit.
strings.Kiedy przysługuje zasiłek dla bezrobotny: When the unemployment benefit is due
strings.Prawo do zasiłku powstaje po wykazaniu c: The right to the benefit arises after proving at least 365 days of work with contributions paid to the Labour Fund within the 18 months immediately before the date of registration (alongside other conditions, e.g. the absence of a suitable job offer).
strings.Start pracy — kilka miesięcy: Start of work — a few months
strings.Ile wynosi i jak długo: How much and for how long
strings.Wysokość zasiłku zależy od stażu pracy (: The amount of the benefit depends on the service period (a correspondingly lower, basic or higher rate), and the payment period (e.g. 180 or 365 days) — on the situation in the local labour market and individual circumstances. Exact amounts and periods are set on the basis of the applicable rules and require checking for a specific case.
strings.Osoba poszukująca pracy i usługi urzędu: A job-seeking person and the office's services
strings.Nawet bez prawa do zasiłku warto się zar: Even without the right to the benefit it is worth registering. After registration a foreigner can use job placement, career counselling, help in actively seeking work and training organised by the labour office.
strings.Od <b>1 czerwca 2025 r.</b> obowiązuje n: Since 1 June 2025 the new Act of 20 March 2025 on the labour market and employment services has been in force, replacing the employment promotion act that had been in effect for over 20 years. It introduces, among others, an ordered catalogue of forms of assistance (benefits, scholarships, training, internships, loans). The detailed conditions for foreigners are worth confirming under the new rules.
strings.Sprawdź, czy masz staż do zasiłku: Check whether you have the service period for the benefit
strings.Podaj okres zatrudnienia i formę umowy —: Give the period of employment and the type of contract — we will calculate whether you are approaching the required 365 days and what residence title you have for registration.
strings.<a class=\"btn btn-gold\" href=\"formula: Fill in the benefit questionnaire Ask on WhatsApp
strings.Po jakim czasie pracy dostanę zasiłek dl: After how long of working will I get the unemployment benefit?
strings.Co do zasady po 365 dniach pracy z opłac: As a rule after 365 days of work with contributions paid to the Labour Fund within the 18 months before registration — and with an appropriate residence title.
strings.Czy mogę zarejestrować się bez prawa do: Can I register without the right to the benefit?
strings.Tak. Rejestracja daje dostęp do usług ry: Yes. Registration gives access to labour-market services (placement, training) even without the right to the benefit.
strings.Czy umowa zlecenia liczy się do stażu?: Does a mandate contract count towards the service period?
strings.Liczy się, jeśli od wynagrodzenia odprow: It counts if Labour Fund contributions were paid on the remuneration.
strings.Nie — potrzebny jest jeden z tytułów pob: No — one of the residence titles specified in the act is needed, e.g. temporary residence and work or a work visa.
strings.Ustawa z 20 marca 2025 r. o rynku pracy: Act of 20 March 2025 on the labour market and employment services (in force from 1 June 2025; replaced the Act of 20 April 2004 on employment promotion and labour market institutions).
strings.Ustawa z 12 grudnia 2013 r. o cudzoziemc: Act of 12 December 2013 on foreigners (residence titles entitling to registration).
strings.Akty wykonawcze do ustawy o rynku pracy: Implementing acts to the act on the labour market and employment services.

strings.Kiedy cudzoziemiec dostanie zasiłek dla: When a foreigner will get the unemployment benefit: registration at the labour office, the required 365 days of work within 18 months, residence titles. The new 2025 labour market act.

strings.Prawo do świadczeń z pomocy społecznej m: The right to social assistance benefits belongs to a narrow, closed catalogue of foreigners (art. 5 of the Social Assistance Act) — most often persons with permanent residence, EU long-term resident status or temporary residence granted on specific grounds (e.g. as a family member of a Polish citizen).
strings.<b>Uwaga:</b> samo zezwolenie na pobyt c: Note: a temporary residence "and work" permit alone usually does not open the right to social assistance. The specific basis of residence decides.
strings.Przy trudnej sytuacji, np. z powodu dług: In a difficult situation, e.g. due to long-term illness or unemployment, when income does not exceed the criterion.
strings.Na konkretny cel — np. żywność, leki, op: For a specific purpose — e.g. food, medicines, fuel, essential unforeseen expenses.
strings.Dla osób niezdolnych do pracy z powodu w: For persons unable to work due to age or disability who meet the criteria.
strings.Na podstawie odrębnej ustawy; zależny od: On the basis of a separate act; depends on income and the size of the dwelling.
strings.Pomoc społeczna jest zależna od dochodu: Social assistance depends on income — an income criterion applies for a single-person household and for a person in a family, set periodically. Exceeding the threshold usually excludes the right to the allowance (with exceptions).
strings.Najczęściej na styku rodzaju pobytu i in: Most often at the intersection of the type of residence and the interpretation of the social assistance centre. The mere fact of working or legal residence is not enough if the provision requires a specific, expressly indicated residence title. That is why, before filing, it is worth checking the exact basis of residence.
strings.Postępowanie zwykle obejmuje <b>wywiad ś: The procedure usually includes a social interview conducted by a social worker. Prepare a residence document, documents confirming income and family situation and — if applicable — rulings and certificates.
strings.Sprawdź, czy kwalifikujesz się do pomocy: Check whether you qualify for social assistance
strings.Podstawa pobytu jest tu kluczowa. Podaj: The basis of residence is key here. Give your residence title — we will assess whether you fall within the catalogue of the eligible.
strings.<a class=\"btn btn-gold\" href=\"formula: Fill in the benefit questionnaire Ask on WhatsApp
strings.Czy pobyt czasowy i praca daje prawo do: Does temporary residence and work give the right to social assistance?
strings.Zwykle nie. Pomoc społeczna przysługuje: Usually not. Social assistance is available to a narrow catalogue of foreigners — the specific basis of residence decides.
strings.Osoby z pobytem stałym, statusem rezyden: Persons with permanent residence, EU long-term resident status or temporary residence granted on specific grounds.
strings.Tak, obowiązuje kryterium dochodowe, ust: Yes, an income criterion applies, set periodically for a single person and for a person in a family.
strings.To rozmowa i ocena sytuacji przeprowadza: It is a conversation and assessment of the situation carried out by a social worker, which conditions the granting of the benefit.
strings.Ustawa z 12 marca 2004 r. o pomocy społe: Act of 12 March 2004 on social assistance (including art. 5 — the catalogue of eligible foreigners).
strings.Ustawa z 21 czerwca 2001 r. o dodatkach: Act of 21 June 2001 on housing supplements.
strings.Ustawa z 12 grudnia 2013 r. o cudzoziemc: Act of 12 December 2013 on foreigners (the residence bases referred to in art. 5).
